description: xMate device tools: observation, robot state, gripper actions and checked joint routes. Scene perception and route construction belong to task code.

plan_joint_routes.description: In one SDK session, try ordered candidates of named sequential phases; select the first fully checked candidate and save independently executable checked routes. Future phases use predicted endpoints; execute_joint_route still checks actual start/context. No movement. Reuse returned routes instead of replanning each phase. See docs/工具与数据契约.md for batch_spec format.
preconditions: Web robot disconnected; robot manual and idle. Task supplies candidate path specs with identical ordered phase names, action/review boundaries, and inspected clearance.
effects: Solve candidate phases then densely check only IK-feasible candidates. No power or movement. Save phase routes with fine final stops and original check digests.
evidence: selected_candidate, routes keyed by phase name, rejected_candidates and log_path; full input and per-phase planning diagnostics in log.

plan_joint_route.description: Convert task-sampled TCP matrices into a checked joint route using live start/toolset, continuous IK/FK and compaction. Path spec optionally sets blend_radius_mm: default 1 mm at intermediate points, final point always fine; 0 requests all fine stops. Inspect blending clearance. No scene perception, collision verdict or motion. Failed planning details are logged. See docs/工具与数据契约.md.
preconditions: Web robot disconnected; robot manual and idle, power may be on or off. Task supplies fresh endInRef target matrices, TCP bounds and optional rate (defaults to config/control.yaml); inspect full-arm/object/cable clearance.
effects: Exclusive SDK read/compute session; save checked route for execute_joint_route. No power or movement.
evidence: checked_route_path, sampled FK, segment_count and timing log. Reuses actual toolset; no fixed 248 mm assumption.

check_joint_route.description: Check an explicit joint route against the live idle robot, SDK limits and sampled FK; save a checked route. No movement or collision verdict. See docs/工具与数据契约.md for route file format.
preconditions: Web robot disconnected; robot manual and idle, power may be on or off.

Route file contains current start_joints_deg, 1..100 waypoints_deg, explicit tcp_bounds_m and rate 0.01..1.0; optional blend_radius_mm is 0 (default for explicit joint files) or 1..5 mm. No fixed per-segment angular range; inspect whole-arm, object and cable clearance including blending.
effects: Connect/read/disconnect SDK under exclusive lock; save immutable-by-convention checked route and log. No commanded motion.
evidence: Sampled joint/FK positions at <=1 degree intervals, 0.5 degree joint-limit margin and abs(J5)>=5 degrees. This is not a complete singularity or collision check.

execute_joint_route.description: Consume one checked joint route. Verify original record and live start/tool/load/frames/limits; reuse matching FK samples. Submit one blended queue with final fine stop. Bind holding_position to the measured grasp position for lift/carrying: five fresh samples before/after motion, contact and drift monitoring during motion, returns holding_verified. Omit after release. Stop, wait idle, power off and disconnect; no retries.
preconditions: Same scene and inspected full-arm clearance as route check; robot manual and idle, power may be on or off; web robot disconnected.
Route must not have been attempted. Content-based marker is written before power or movement; renaming the file does not permit replay.
effects: Robot power and physical joint motion at route rate; no automatic mode changes, gripper commands or photos. SDK worker holds device ownership and stops on feedback/lease failure.
evidence: Controller waypoint progress, feedback timings, stable route endpoint, final TCP and power. TCP bounds alone do not cover arm, fingers, carried object or cables; no task-success verdict.

holding_position.description: Bind to close_gripper.actual for lift and every carrying route. Requires fresh five-sample contact before/after motion and monitors contact/position during motion. Omit after release. Register units, not mm.

observe.description: Read selected resident RGB/gripper sources. Saves RGB PNG and original metadata; no motion, connection changes, initialization, localization or cross-source synchronization. Use robot_state for separate idle SDK feedback.
preconditions: Resident web service running and selected sensors connected via sensor_client.py; no automatic connection or direct-device fallback.
effects: No commanded motion; device connections may still affect ownership.
evidence: rgb.image_path/metadata_path/metadata and/or raw gripper.state/samples/stable feedback. collected_at is completion time, not synchronized capture time; contact is not proof of carrying.

web_url.description: Local resident HTTP origin; defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8080.

after.description: Host monotonic timestamp after settling; default 0. Never wall-clock time.

robot_state.description: Query an idle robot in a separate SDK Python process via sdk_runtime. No power, mode changes or movement; disconnect after reading.
preconditions: Robot must already be idle; SDK connection/disconnection can affect motion.
Resident web service running with its robot disconnected; SDK owner lock must be free.
evidence: Original SDK query names in values, including posture, tools and limits; collected_at is completion time, not a synchronized sample.

move_gripper.description: Send one gripper opening/closing target in raw units; existing controller limits each move to 500, uses config/control.yaml force and verifies feedback. No robot approach or release-geometry checking.
preconditions: Resident gripper connected and initialized, at rest; robot web connection disconnected.
Caller determines support and finger clearance. A raw target is not a checked placement.
effects: Physical gripper action with existing feedback guards; no automatic retry.
evidence: Actual opening and controller feedback; no image, detachment proof or automatic full opening.

close_gripper.description: Close once from empty fully open 1000 until stable contact, using existing grasp_close guards. Does not approach, lift or prove carrying.
preconditions: Resident gripper initialized, status 1 and position 1000; robot web connection disconnected.
Target endpoint must fit current object/scene; no contact causes failure, not a successful grasp.
effects: Physical gripper action with existing feedback guards; no automatic retry.
evidence: Five-sample stable contact result only; no object identity, pose or carrying verdict.
